Repair Spotlights

Featured Repair Details

What to look for when comparing repairs. The images in this section illustrate inspection techniques.

Spotting a Door Ding

Focus Door panelLook for Intact paint

A small ding can be hard to see straight on. Look at the panel from an angle and watch how a reflected line bends around the dent. The paint can still be intact even when the metal has moved.

  • Use an angled photo to show the shape of the ding
  • Include the whole panel so we can see its location
  • Mention any chips or cracks in the paint
  • Ask for an assessment if you’re unsure

Reading the Reflections

Focus InspectionLook for Panel contours

A striped inspection light makes changes in the shape of the metal easier to spot. Comparing the way those lines move across the panel can help you see where a dent begins and ends.

  • Look for bends where reflected lines should run straight
  • Check how the reflection follows the body line
  • Compare similar viewing angles when possible
  • Remember that lighting can change how a panel looks
